snippet.title: Bluy Leaves Home Demo (Trailer)
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5028800/Bluy_Leaves_Home/

The story is about Bluy, who is on a mission to stop an evil gang from taking his brother. His main mission starting from saving his brother, to saving the continent of Metro from violence.

September 15, 2026.






Editing/Gameplay by A

Gameplay also by N

Logo and animation in video by @Certified64 

Bluy animation design by @turtleyoshii 

Song by N

We can't forget little oshy!
